name: frame_slot_off
subs: const uint32_t sp0 = R(15), pr0 = a->pr, obj = R(4), frame = sp0 - 44u;
const uint32_t sp0 = R(15), pr0 = a->pr, obj = R(4), frame = sp0 - 40u;

name: third_table_off
subs: vf3_aim_set_u32(a, frame - 4u, R(11));       /* the third table, on the stack */
vf3_aim_set_u32(a, frame - 8u, R(11));       /* the third table, on the stack */

name: sr_t_clear
subs: a->sr |= 1u;                                            /* the last tst r13,r13 found it zero */
a->sr &= ~1u;                                           /* the last tst r13,r13 found it zero */
